ios.desc:
Desk Remote Control is a small utility application that lets you easily control your height adjustable standing desk right from your iPhone. Just say "Hey Siri, move my desk" or "Hey Siri, move the desk to the sit/stand/fav position". Easily switch between sit, stand and fav positions by simply pressing one button. No need to press and hold the key on the desk. Please see the list of supported bluetooth desks for details.

FEATURES:
• Easy pairing over bluetooth
• Automatically re-connects to known desks
• Displays current height and sit/stand memory positions
• Lets you move the desk up or down
• Allows to set favourite sit and stand positions
• Rename the desk
• Height calibration. For a more accurate display of the desk height
• Support for Siri Shortcuts

And even more if you buy PRO FEATURES:
• Automatically moves desk to sit or stand position with 1 touch. No need to hold the button down in the app
• Use Siri to switch back and forth between sit and stand positions
• Add a shortcut to Siri and then run it anytime by asking Siri
• Get more options for customizing your workspace - use additional 'Fav' position

SUPPORTED DESKS:
• The app is tested and should work fine with IKEA Idasen sit/standing desk.
• 'Easydesk Line' desk from boho office
• The app may work with LINAK desk systems using DPG bluetooth desk panel.

Do not hesitate to contact me at support@kaasoft.com

Terms of Use: https://www.kaasoft.com/termsofuse
Privacy Policy: https://www.kaasoft.com/privacy
